summary: Psychology Dashboard Redesign testing completed successfully. All 20 features tested and passed. Dashboard shows sidebar with 8 navigation items (Inicio, Estudiantes, Fichas Clinicas, Sesiones, Mensajes Padres, Agenda, Talleres, Mi Perfil), DashboardHeader with school logo, welcome message, date, user profile (Ana/Psicologo/a/AN avatar), notification bell. 4 colored metric cards (En Seguimiento-blue, Sesiones de Abril-green, Nuevos Casos-purple, Citas de Hoy-orange) with navigation. Quick action cards, Citas de Hoy section, Proximos Talleres section, and Sesiones Recientes section all working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Psychology Dashboard Redesign complete. All sidebar navigation, metric cards, quick actions, and section links working. Sidebar expands on hover showing full labels. Header shows school logo, welcome message, date, user profile with dropdown. Notification bell present with badge.
